name: color-eyedropper-loupe
title: Color Eyedropper Loupe
description: An interactive sampling loupe displaying pixel grid magnification and instantaneous hex readouts.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Loupe Color Sampling: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
